name: SupermarketShoppingFamilyShoppingChaos

custom.system_prompt:
You are generating realistic near-future supermarket conversations with a family of three — two parents and an 8-year-old. Using Sigma is normal. Matej has discovered that asking Sigma things sometimes works better than asking his parents. The shop is constantly interrupted by Matej.

Write dialogue that sounds like real people. Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters. No exceptions.
- Matej talks fast, changes subject, and has strong opinions about snacks
- Parents speak in couple shorthand — they have a system that Matej disrupts
- Sigma is asked at least once by a parent and once by or for Matej
- The chaos is warm, not stressful — this is just how their shopping goes

sound_effects_config.prompt: Busy supermarket, shopping cart, child running, store announcements, background crowd noise

initial_prompt:
Generate a family shopping conversation between Katia, Andrei, and their 8-year-old son Matej. Katia and Andrei are trying to do a functional weekly shop. Matej keeps drifting towards snacks, asking questions, disappearing around a corner, and re-appearing with something they didn't need. Sigma is used at least once by Katia for a practical question and at least once Matej asks Sigma something directly (or gets his parents to ask for him). A brief parent exchange about something outside the shop — the week, a plan — happens when Matej is briefly distracted.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Matej is energetic and persistent, not bratty
- Parents are warm but firm
- Sigma answers clearly and briefly — Matej accepts this
- At least one 'where did Matej go' moment

setting.mood: Warm chaos. They're used to this.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Competent parents, an energetic child who knows how the system works

scenario_template.topic: Matej immediately has opinions about where to go first
scenario_template.note: Matej heads to the wrong aisle. Parents redirect him. The shop begins.

scenario_template.topic: Katia asks Sigma a practical question while Matej is briefly occupied
scenario_template.note: Sigma answers. Andrei responds. Brief exchange before Matej reappears.

scenario_template.topic: Matej finds something he wants — first negotiation begins
scenario_template.note: Persistent but not explosive. Parents united front. Brief back and forth.

scenario_template.topic: Matej has wandered somewhere — parents notice
scenario_template.note: Quick exchange. He's in the cereal aisle. Of course he is.

scenario_template.topic: Matej asks Sigma a direct question — or persuades a parent to ask for him
scenario_template.note: A genuine question Matej has — about a product, an ingredient, something he's curious about. Sigma answers simply.

scenario_template.topic: While Matej looks at something — a brief parent exchange about the week or a plan
scenario_template.note: A few turns of normal adult conversation. Matej interrupts it.

scenario_template.topic: Matej spots colorful fruits and gets excited
scenario_template.note: Matej is drawn to the fruit display and exclaims about the bright colors, leading to a short discussion with Katia about healthy snacks.

scenario_template.topic: Andrei shares a childhood memory
scenario_template.note: Andrei sees a product that triggers a memory from his own shopping trips as a child, sharing it briefly with Katia.

scenario_template.topic: Matej links a product to superheroes
scenario_template.note: Matej picks up a box and claims it's related to superhero powers, sparking a small imaginative conversation with Katia.

scenario_template.topic: Parents discuss an impromptu plan for the afternoon
scenario_template.note: Katia and Andrei briefly brainstorm a fun family activity for after the shopping, between tasks.

scenario_template.topic: Matej finds a sticker and wants it
scenario_template.note: Matej discovers a colorful sticker on a product and engages Andrei in a negotiation to take it home.

scenario_template.topic: Katia realizes part of the shopping list is missing
scenario_template.note: Katia and Andrei have a quick, slightly frantic exchange as they attempt to remember the rest of the list while Matej meanders.

scenario_template.topic: Matej imagines the store as a jungle
scenario_template.note: Matej acts out a small adventure scene, pretending the store is a jungle, while his parents humor his imagination briefly.

scenario_template.topic: Matej checks the basket for smoothie supplies
scenario_template.note: Matej wants to make sure they have what he needs for smoothies and quizzes Katia about the ingredients.

scenario_template.topic: Rain starts while they're inside
scenario_template.note: Andrei notices the rain pouring outside and they discuss how it might affect their post-shopping plans.

scenario_template.topic: Nearly done — final Matej negotiation and heading to checkout
scenario_template.note: A small resolution — something Matej gets or doesn't. Heading out.

scenario_template.topic: The child taking it extremely seriously
scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: One item badly misread
scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: They try to settle it themselves and fail.
scenario_template.note: A genuine attempt that does not resolve it.

scenario_template.topic: One asks Sigma what a particular item on the list means.
scenario_template.note: One of them addresses Sigma by name, under 70 characters. Sigma answers in one or two sentences. Nothing before this phase is addressed to the assistant.

scenario_template.topic: The conversation returns to whatever it was on, unfinished.
scenario_template.note: Sigma is not addressed again.

user1.role: Runs the shop. Tracks the list, manages Matej with practiced patience. Asks Sigma when she needs a fact.

user2.name: Andrei
user2.role: Helps with the cart and occasionally gets distracted by something interesting on the shelf. Backs Katia on Matej decisions.

user3.name: Matej
user3.role: 8-year-old who treats the supermarket as an adventure. Wants snacks. Will ask Sigma things if he thinks it'll help. Short lines, fast subject changes.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Practical assistant. Answers adult questions clearly. Answers Matej's questions simply and appropriately for a child. Does not take sides in snack negotiations.

conversation_structure: Every line under 70 characters. Matej's lines especially should be short and energetic.
Matej must have a distinct voice — fast, curious, persistent, warm.
Parents speak to each other and to Matej differently — different register.
Sigma is addressed twice — once by a parent, once by Matej or via a parent.
At least one 'where did Matej go' moment.
The chaos is affectionate, not stressful.
assistant_behavior: Sigma answers clearly regardless of who asks.
When Matej asks, Sigma answers simply — age-appropriate but not condescending.
Sigma does not weigh in on the snack negotiation.
Sigma answers in one or two sentences.
